name: Storm-Tossed Sea
disable: DC 29 Athletics check, Crafting, or Sailing Lore to securely lash one's self to the ship. Creatures tied to the ship are immune to the hazard's routine but are Immobilized.
routine:
(1 action) The storm tosses the ship in a random direction (roll 1d8 to determine). All creatures on the ship that aren't lashed to it are moved 10 feet in that direction and must attempt a DC 30 Reflex save save or Sailing Lore check as the waves pummel them.

---
Critical Success The creature takes no damage and can avoid being moved 10 feet if it wishes.
Success The creature takes no damage.
Failure The creature is Off-Guard and takes 1d12+15 bludgeoning damage.
Critical Failure The creature is Prone and takes 2d12+15 bludgeoning damage.

items.name: Storm Surge
items.text:
Trigger The storm builds for at least 10 minutes

---
Effect The ship pitches dangerously atop the waves. The hazard rolls initiative and performs its routine as a free action.

text: A relentless storm assails the ship, battering those on board who don't secure themselves.
